_comment: Parameter sweep configuration for PSHB model.
_mode_options: one_at_a_time  : vary one parameter while all others stay at their default
full_factorial : run every combination of all sweep values (can be large!)
_sweep_note: First value of each list = baseline for one_at_a_time mode. Keep it aligned with PSHBEnvironment defaults.
_heap_comment: Max JVM heap per run (-Xmx). heap x parallel_jobs must stay under ~13 GB on a 16 GB machine (leaves ~3 GB for OS + JVM native overhead).
_parallel_comment: Number of runs to execute in parallel. Set to 1 for sequential.
